caption: Talk
lines: I can mix stones into weapons and also create Imperial weapons.
To mix a stone into a weapon, bring me:
Each mix step uses one stone. The first mix is Grade 1.
Mix again (same or different stone) to reach Grade 2 of the new stone.
Grade 3 is Stone of Mystery or Stone of Demon's Blood. Those only
work on a Grade 2 weapon and need two stones of the same type.
To make an Imperial weapon, bring the grades from the mix list:
main weapon + extra weapon + armor + two identical stones.
Grade 50 needs a Grade 50 extra weapon and a Grade 46 chest — the same
grades as the mix list, for both upgrading and making.
Be careful: the materials are consumed even when mixing fails.
